How I Work

From brief to frame.

01
Understand the brief
Every project starts with a question: what does this need to do for the person watching? I get the goal, the platform, and the audience before touching a keyframe.
02
Concept & storyboard
I sketch the flow — timing, pacing, key moments. This is where I make decisions, not in the timeline. Good motion is 80% planned, 20% discovered.
03
Build & animate
Into After Effects and Blender. I work modularly — assets, rigs, render passes — so revisions are fast and the final composite is clean.
04
Deliver & document
Final export in every format needed. Plus a short breakdown of what was made and why — so you can brief the next piece faster.
